summary: The assigned replay reaches Quest Home 4 at recorded step 787 after the already implemented Wiz-fila level at step 784. The C level generator is at absolute depth 18 and its mklev.c depth-gated ordinary-level branch selects ZOO=8, so mkroom.c do_mkroom() dispatches to mkzoo(ZOO) and later fill_special_room() stocks it. JavaScript makelevel() reaches the same branch, but js/mkroom.js do_mkroom() omits ZOO and throws before the existing mkzoo/fill_zoo path can run. The owner is the C mkroom.c dispatcher and its whole function scope; this is not a Lua-level loader mismatch. Completing the whole function also requires the remaining C dispatch cases and their source-backed fillers: mkswamp() has no JavaScript owner, and ANTHOLE, COCKNEST, and LEPREHALL still stop in fill_special_room().

The current JS dispatcher handles shops, TEMPLE, COURT, BEEHIVE, MORGUE, and BARRACKS but throws for ZOO and the other omitted cases.
